subject: Clarify audit & access log retention + export options for Acme Health
messages:
From: Alex Jordan <alex.jordan@acmehealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: 2026-10-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Audit & access logs — retention windows and export capabilities

Jonas,

We're reviewing Redwood for a production deployment and need to confirm a few things about audit/access logs:

- What's the default retention for audit and access logs for the hosted tenant?
- Do you support long-term retention (1–7 years) and is that a configurable addon?
- Can we export the complete tenant audit/access trail (raw events + metadata) to our S3 (us-east-1)? Supported formats?
- Do exports include verification (hash manifest) and can Redwood delete retained logs on request with an evidence package?
- Where are the logs stored (region/zone)? We need residency for PHI workloads.

Can you send the shortest possible summary and any playbooks or contract language we should propose to our legal team?

Thanks,
Alex Jordan
Head of Security
Acme Health
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Jordan <alex.jordan@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-05T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Audit & access logs — retention windows and export capabilities

Alex — thanks for the clear list. Short summary up front, followed by specifics.

Short answer:
- Default hosted retention: 90 days for audit/access logs. Enterprise options: configurable up to 7 years (paid addon or Dedicated/Private).
- Export options: bulk export snapshots (JSONL, Parquet), push to customer S3 (pre-signed or direct push), and live syslog/TLS streaming to SIEMs.
- Exports include a manifest with SHA256 checksums and schema version. We can also provide a signed checksum.
- Deletion: Redwood can remove logs from our systems per contract; we provide an export + deletion certificate. For legal/forensics holds we support retention holds.
- Residency: logs are stored in the tenant's configured region (we support US, EU, APAC regions). For PHI you should choose a single-region Dedicated or Private deployment.

Attachments: audit-export-sample-manifest.csv (sample manifest schema)

I'll loop in Karthik (security/solutions) for the technical playbook and an export runbook. If you're open, we can book a 30-minute call to walk legal/procurement through the contract language and timeline.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Jordan <alex.jordan@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-06T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Audit & access logs — retention windows and export capabilities

Alex,

Adding technical detail you can share with your infra and legal team.

Retention tiers
- Hosted (multi-tenant): 90-day default rolling window. Snapshots for longer-term retention can be scheduled; costs scale with retention and query SLA.
- Dedicated/Private: configurable retention up to 7 years. We offer cold-tier archiving with object-store-backed snapshots.

Export mechanics
- Bulk snapshots: generated on-demand or scheduled (daily/weekly/monthly). Output formats: newline-delimited JSON (JSONL) and Parquet (columnar). Each snapshot includes an index and schema metadata file.
- Delivery: presigned S3 PUT (recommended for large exports), direct S3 write (with customer IAM role), or secure HTTPS download. We can also stream real-time audit events via syslog/TLS (RFC5424) to your collector.
- Manifest & verification: every snapshot includes manifest.csv with file-level SHA256 checksums and a manifest.signature (signed by Redwood KMS key). We also provide an export ID to correlate with our audit trail.

Deletion & attestations
- Redwood deletion workflow: once deletion is requested and the retention hold (if any) is cleared, we remove tenant artifacts from hot/cold stores. We keep a hidden, immutable audit record of the deletion operation (who/when/export id) for our internal compliance — we share a deletion certificate (timestamped, signed) with customers.
- Note: if exports are delivered to your S3, we cannot delete the objects in your bucket; you must run your own retention policy there.

Residency and certifications
- Data-at-rest for logs is in the tenant region. For PHI we recommend Dedicated in a single region + customer-managed KMS.
- We are SOC 2 Type II audited; evidence for export handling can be provided as part of an audit pack.

Operational notes
- Export generation window: typical snapshot for up to 90 days completes within 2–6 hours; multi-year exports can take longer — plan for 24–72 hours depending on size.
- Pricing: export bandwidth and storage transfer apply; extension to 3-year retention is a billable addon — we'll provide a quote after sizing.

Attachment: export-playbook-quickstart.pdf (runbook and API examples)

If useful, I can include sample CLI/API commands (GET /v1/exports/audit-logs?start=...&end=...) and a short runbook we can drop into your procurement SOW.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Alex Jordan <alex.jordan@acmehealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-07T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Audit & access logs — retention windows and export capabilities

Team — this is great, thanks. Please go ahead and schedule the 30-minute call; include our procurement and legal leads (procurement@acmehealth.com and legal@acmehealth.com).

Two quick asks before the call:
1) Can you produce an example contract clause we can drop into our DPA covering: export delivery SLA, deletion attestations, and responsibility split for exported artifacts?
2) We need an initial sizing quote to keep 3 years of audit logs for ~120k MAUs (estimate) — bullet-level cost estimate will do.

If you can send the playbook and sample clause before midday PST tomorrow that would help speed our internal review.

Appreciate it,
Alex
